Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR KNEE JOINT WITHOUT LOCK 
FOR STEEL ORTHOPAEDIC CALIPERS 



1. Scope— Dimensional and other requirements for knee joint without lock for steel orthopaedic 
calipers. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

3. Material — Carbon steel conforming to Designation C30 or C35 of Schedule II of 1570-1961 
' Schedules for wrought steels for general engineering purposes '.

IS: 5963- 1971 

4. Workmanship and Finish — The component parts of the joint shall be accurately and cleanly 
machined, and the joint faces shall be finished clean and free from toolmarks. Fabrication by welding 
or brazing shall not be allowed. The parts after assembly shall give a smooth jerk-free movement while 
flexing the joint. The outside surfaces of the joint and the shanks shall be free from forging scale. All 
sharp edges and corners shall be rounded. The components shall be free from surface flaws and cracks. 
All surfaces shall be finished smooth, 

5. Marking — The joint shall be marked with the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) Size of the joint (see Fig. 1 ). 

5.1 ISI Certification Marking— Details available from the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1. 

6. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Printed at Delhi Printers. Delhi 6, India
